Question: Circle \(C_1\) has its center \(O\) lying on circle \(C_2.\) The two circles meet at \(X\) and \(Y.\) Point \(Z\) in the exterior of \(C_1\) lies on circle \(C_2\) and \(XZ = 13,\) \(OZ = 11,\) and \(YZ = 7.\) What is the radius of circle \(C_1?\)
